main_text.p: 5. Judex externus & visibilis esse debet, qui ab omnibus conspiciatur & audiatur, & praeterea autoritatem coactivam habeat. At talis non est Scriptura. Ergo.

R. In Majore cavenda est confusio Judicis spiritualis, cum humano & corporali: normalis cum personali. Minor vero falsa est, simpliciter accepta. Nam Spiritus S. in Scriptura le-ctâ & audita, ab omnibus auditur, & autoritatem habet coa-ctivam, non tyrannicam, sed efficacem, ad instituendum pios & convincendum impios.
6. Scriptura est ipsa litis materia. Ergo non potest esse Judex. Ratio ; quia nemo simul Reus & Judex, aut sui ipsius Judex est.

R. Falsum est Antecedens; nō enim Scriptura ipsa, sed variae Scripturae interpretationes & controversiae, litis sunt ma-teria. Sed & Consequentia laborat; etsi enim in judiciis huma-nis, nemo de se ipso testari aut judicare queat, alia tamen est ratio Judicis divini, qui cum mentiri ne-queat, testis est omni exceptio-ne major.

page.notes: Woodcut ornament (mask with rams' heads, scrollwork, tassels) below the text, not transcribed. Faint show-through of text from the other side is visible in the margins and between the lines; not transcribed. A faint "E" near the bottom left is probably show-through and is not transcribed as a signature. The Greek line is copied as printed; the accents and breathings could not be checked at this resolution, so they may be imperfect.
